overall_summary: The channel heavily indexes on 'self respect' with micro-interactions on mobile devices (deleting chats, changing settings, clearing storage). While views are modest, topics centered around decisive personal boundaries (like chat deletion and status/last seen changes) outperform vague emotional states. Confidence remains moderate due to low sample sizes and uniform engagement metrics across uploads.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing purely on abstract night thoughts or generic waiting (e.g., 'uIbMpCjVutQ' with 6 views, 'hT4EGP69mRw' with 3 views) underperform compared to active boundary-setting.
weak_patterns.action: Reduce abstract late-night rambling and anchor every emotional concept to a tangible, everyday action.
